metadata.title: Mid-Century Soul Graphic Album Cover
useCases: Retro soul or funk event posters

retrievalProfile.description: A high-impact typographic layout featuring heavy sans-serif blocks, a warm mustard background, and vertical pinstripe framing characteristic of 1960s soul and R&B record covers.
excludeWhen: modern minimalist white space is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered typographic composition on a warm ochre-mustard field, framed by dense vertical black pinstripes on the left and right edges. The layout uses massive, blocky sans-serif type in contrasting red, black, and purple, organized into a clear hierarchy with horizontal rules and square bullet points separating secondary text elements.
coreVisualRelationships: Large-scale display type dominates the upper half
Vertical pinstripe borders compress the central workspace
Horizontal rules and square bullets organize the lower tracklist area
High-contrast color blocks create rhythmic visual weight
coreInvariants: Dense vertical line borders on lateral edges
Tri-color palette of red, black, and muted purple

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Typography is the primary subject, centered horizontally and filling 80% of the width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The largest red display word at the top acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Vertical descent from the massive header down through the secondary artist name to the grid-like list at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Tight margins created by the pinstripe borders; internal space is filled with dense type blocks.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Mustard yellow/ochre background providing a warm, vintage base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep red for primary display text and horizontal dividers.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted purple-blue for the secondary artist name and black for tertiary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red and yellow with low-value black for grounding.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold, condensed sans-serif with flat terminals.
letterConstructionRules: Squared-off counters in the largest display size
characterSpecificRedesigns: Exclamation points rendered as thick vertical bars
Italicization used only for the secondary artist name
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrasting weights and slants within the same sans-serif family; color used to differentiate hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, condensed weight of the primary display text.
Matches the secondary artist name's slant and weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid mustard-yellow square background. Add a series of 10-15 thin vertical black lines on both the far left and far right edges to create a pinstripe border effect.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Center-align bold, condensed sans-serif text. Use red for the top header, black for the 'Here's' line, and purple-blue for the italicized artist name. Below, create a grid of track titles separated by small square bullets and horizontal red lines.

verificationChecks: Are the vertical pinstripes present on both sides?
Is the background a warm mustard yellow?
Is the primary header text in a heavy red sans-serif?
Are horizontal rules used to separate the bottom text sections?

adjustableVariables: Color of the secondary italicized text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is perfectly centered horizontally.
Verify the pinstripes do not overlap the central text area.
Check that the red horizontal lines are consistent in thickness.
Confirm the color palette remains within the warm retro spectrum.
recipe.reuseFormula: Mustard field + vertical pinstripe borders + ultra-bold condensed red header + italicized secondary name + grid-based tracklist.
